text: Which pair of tools performs "ab initio" gene prediction — inferring gene structure from statistical models rather than direct transcript or protein evidence?
explanation: AUGUSTUS and GeneMark use Hidden Markov Models of gene structure (codon usage, splice sites, start/stop codons) without requiring RNA-seq or homology evidence, which is the definition of ab initio prediction. Trinity and StringTie build evidence-based transcript assemblies from RNA-seq reads, MAKER and BRAKER are pipelines that integrate ab initio predictions with RNA-seq and/or protein homology evidence, and InterProScan/BLAST are functional annotation tools applied after genes have already been predicted.
